statements.description: Article 22.27 applies only to the following activities at locations designated in the environmental plan as national protected city or village views: (a) indoor modifications; (b) changes to a rear facade or rear roof surface if that facade or roof surface does not face publicly accessible areas; (c) a building on a building yard at the back of a main building, if that building yard is not also part of the building yard at the side of that building and does not face publicly accessible areas; or (d) a building on a location that is part of publicly accessible areas.

statements.description: The introductory clause and subparagraphs a and b of Article 22.27 do not apply if the temporary part of this environmental plan, as referred to in Article 22.1(a) of the Environmental Act, contains rules about conducting archaeological research in the context of an application for an environmental permit for a building activity at the location where the building activity is carried out, unless (a) the building concerned has a surface area of less than 50 m²; or (b) the temporary part of this environmental plan contains a prohibition on carrying out earthworks necessary for the building activity without an environmental permit, to which rules about conducting archaeological research in the context of an application for an environmental permit for performing a work, not being a building, or an activity apply.
